build_CLIPTransform: build a CLIPTransform module to preprocess images and text for CLIP model inference
create_CLIPBPETokenizer: create a CLIPBPETokenizer to encode text into BPE token IDs and decode tokens back to text
create_CLIPTextTransform: create a CLIPTextTransform nn.Module to tokenize text with BPE, add start/end tokens, and pad to max length
create_CLIPImageTransform: create a CLIPImageTransform nn.Module to resize, crop, normalize PIL images into tensors for CLIP
test_CLIPBPETransform: test the CLIPBPETransform module to tokenize a single string or list of strings into BPE token sequences
